comments.content:
When clubbing someone 50 times over the head with a toolbox, if enough
damage is inflicted it should start saying something in the clubbing
message that the victim is, quite obviously, dead.

This would be a message that shows up probably after 2x deadly damage is
applied so it would not be an instant indicator of life or death, but
merely a "yes his brain is now seperated from his skull you can stop
swinging now" message.

I believe that it's impossible to kill someone more quickly just by toolboxing them
more. Once they're below 0 health (i.e. unconscious), the only damage they take is
the suffocation damage from being unconscious and gasping. But a "last gasp" message
would indeed be nice.

deathgasp patch, adds:

- deathgasp emote (triggered upon mob dying)
- examine on a mob will now have an extra line if the person is unconscious/dead
Something's wrong with that patchfile, I can't apply it anyways.

The dead person now receives a memory-window popup stating their Time of Death (See
patch in Issue #28); don't know if this is desireable enough but it does the trick IMHO.

I don't think they were worried the dead person knew they were dead. The attacker
could use a helpful message as well.

tbh i think this is a bad idea, better damage indicators would be nice but this
particular thing sucks.
